text:
Olivia (AE): quick heads-up — Lyra Finance got back with an RFI + a POC ask. They want a 2-week onprem-ish eval, network egress whitelist, and a line-itemed quote for reserved capacity. they also attached a 400-row security questionnaire :grimacing:

Jamie (Solutions): ok can you drop the RFI here? i can audit the checklist and call out must-haves vs nice-to-haves.

Olivia (AE): pasted the doc link: https://drive.redwood/lyra/rfi-2026 (internal) plus their POC scope in the sheet. key asks: private VPC, customer KMS, HSM for keywrap, and perf target of p99 < 200ms for chat endpoint.

Ricardo (SRE): for p99 <200ms we need to know query QPS distribution and sequence lengths. can we ask them for sample traces? also, onprem option — do they expect us to ship appliance or run in their cloud VPC?

Olivia (AE): they said "customer-managed VPC (Azure) with expressroute" and "we'd prefer not to host any persistent GPUs in our tenancy" — so Private deployment in their cloud. i'll ask for traces.

Anita (Pricing): for a 2-week POC + dedicated capacity reservation window, quick back-of-envelope: minimum 2 GPUs reserved for POC (NVIDIA A10x or equivalent) + 2-week engineering support. pricing will be: monthly reserved rate prorated + one-time onboarding fee. will spin numbers.

Jamie (Solutions): security questionnaire: they flagged KMS/HSM integration and separation of control plane logs. sec-bot ran a quick search and flagged our current docs.

sec-bot: automated note — our standard private deployment supports customer KMS via external keywrap (KMIP / cloud-kms integrations). HSM on customer side is supported; Redwood can integrate with BYOK flows. see: https://internal.redwood/docs/private-kms-integration

Ricardo (SRE): network/egress needs: they require static egress IPs for allowlisting. we'll provide a short list of NAT IPs for control-plane egress and a separate set for telemetry. sample config snippet for their infra team:

```
# Example: allow outbound to Redwood control plane
aws_route_table_association:
  - destination_cidr_block: 52.54.122.0/24  # control-plane
  - destination_cidr_block: 52.54.128.0/24  # telemetry
```

Jamie (Solutions): also highlight rollbacks/fallbacks — if our private cluster can't serve a heavy batch, we can fallback to a smaller open model hosted option but with data-flow constraints. need legal sign-off.

Olivia (AE): legal asked for a clean data-flow diagram. Jamie, can you draft one? i'll include it with the RFI answer.

Anita (Pricing): draft quote attached (internal): line items = reserved GPUs (2 x monthly prorated), POC support (2 engs x 40h), private deployment setup, KMS integration effort. estimated ARR if converted = $XXXk/yr.

Olivia (AE): next steps: 1) ask Lyra for sample traces + egress ASN list (sending now), 2) Jamie to produce data-flow + capability matrix (must-have vs nice), 3) Ricardo to produce network/IP and perf-runbook doc, 4) Anita to lock provisional pricing. i'll consolidate into RFI response doc and send by EOD tomorrow.

Ricardo (SRE): ack. i'll include a short stress test plan and a canary rollback playbook.

Jamie (Solutions): i'll mark rows in the capability matrix where we need legal sign-off (data residency & fallback).

Olivia (AE): thanks team :raised_hands: — ping me if you need me to prod Lyra for faster traces.

deploy-bot: deployment-ticket created #POC-7123 (owner: Ricardo).
